title: Synthetic catalog and glyph icons incorrectly represented reality
symptom: The public PoC generated 10000 mock package rows and used Unicode glyphs as if they were software icons.
root_cause: Synthetic model was used as the default data source and icon metadata was absent.
resolution: Use local pacman and XDG metadata, preserve desktop Icon provenance; isolate stress data behind explicit stress mode; target-host GUI integration remains unverified.
prevention: Mock counts need clear labels, update state stays unknown until checked and icon identity must come from actual desktop metadata.
